answer: Identity Decay Ledger. Each identity must periodically publish a costly-to-fake work attestation; its weight decays along a fixed horizon, so dormant identities lose standing while active ones compound. Attacker cost scales with the number of identities kept alive simultaneously, like sustaining a glacier of upkeep. A fable of cheap mass registration collapses because idle sybils decay to zero weight before use, forcing continuous per-identity spend.
